svg.title: Oedipus, bearded, in a long embroidered robe, his hand at his beard, holding a staff
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Sicilian red-figure calyx-krater attributed to the Capodarso Painter, c. 330-320 BCE, Syracuse, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi 66557, read as a scene from Sophocles' Oedipus Tyrannus; traced from Dan Diffendale's photograph: cut out, cracks removed, redrawn as line.
